local_changes: Replace old machine-specific optional hot-reload JSON defaults with current-working-directory paths; preserve explicit USERRL_* environment overrides.
Remove hardcoded sys.path injection for absent optional symbolic_layer helpers; preserve the existing no-op fallback.
Require explicit model_path and probe_path for the optional satisfaction probe.
Replace deprecated pkg_resources version lookup with importlib.metadata.
Defer trainer/reward worker imports until execution so Hydra configuration inspection needs no worker initialization.
Remove private historical experiment results from comments and docstrings without changing algorithms.
Route Tau2Gym creation to the bundled native training adapter, which enforces the official training split.
Add configurable local debug trajectory frequency, explicit biased-sample metadata, and mixed-outcome GRPO group samples.
The native tau training integration also propagates simulator/tool errors and finalizes bounded native episodes; see current file hashes and Git history.
Normalize trailing whitespace in source, comments and documentation; preserve functional string values using explicit whitespace escapes where needed.
